ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white/bright) pixels restricted to <3% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of uniform dark pigmentation. Discrete high-contrast clusters of white and tan pixels are mapped to the extreme distal tips of both lobes. A single high-intensity white circular blob is located on the interior medial region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; angle estimated at approximately 75 degrees, with the vertex partially obscured by water disturbance.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across both lobes. The right lobe trailing edge displays more prominent peaks with pixel amplitudes between 10-20 pixels. The left lobe exhibits a more moderate serration frequency.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature sweeping upward from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two dense clusters of circular, multi-toned (white/brown) high-contrast pixels located at the terminal points of both fluke lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct linear pixel disruptions present on both lobes. Left lobe features an 'X'-shaped intersection of two linear marks. Right lobe shows multiple parallel diagonal scratches (rake marks) extending across the ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the tips and clear linear rake marks across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent high-intensity white focal spot on the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe.
